item.title: 25 TROOPERS GRADUATE MSHP LAW ENFORCEMENT ACADEMY
item.description: The Missouri State Highway Patrol announced that 25 troopers graduated from the Patrol’s Law Enforcement Academy on Friday, December 19. The Honorable Robin Ransom, Supreme Court of Missouri, administered the Oath of Office to the new troopers.
